name: ToolQA
description: ToolQA is a dataset designed to evaluate large language models' ability to use external tools for question answering, distinguishing questions answerable by internal knowledge from those requiring external tool use. It includes 13 specialized tools and minimizes overlap with LLM pre-training data to precisely assess tool-use reasoning.
reputation: A specialized tool-use QA benchmark that is cited in tool-augmentation and agent-evaluation research, but it has limited broad community adoption compared with larger general QA benchmarks.
notes: Dataset created via scalable automated curation with 13 specialized tools; aims to minimize overlap with LLM pretraining data.
